submission.implementation_notes: Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one script that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. The plain validator text of `Plinth_1.45.0.0_Unisay_plain`; on this line the plugin options live in the Cabal file, so the module carries no plugin pragmas. Compiled with Plinth 1.64.0.0 and the `datatypes=BuiltinCasing` plugin flag. Builtin casing has been a mainnet feature since the van Rossem hard fork (protocol version 11, 2026-07-18); plutus-tx-plugin 1.67 dropped the flag and enables casing under the default `SumsOfProducts`.
